Title: Add browser-level smoke coverage for the main app routes: `/memories`, `/pages`, `/chat`, and `/health`.
Description:
Problem: the repo has route and API coverage, but no browser-level smoke pass proving the core workbench pages render together under a live app session.

Desired outcome:
- Add a repeatable browser smoke workflow for `/memories`, `/pages`, `/chat`, `/health`, and `/tasks`.
- Persist a minimal screenshot or pass/fail artifact set so regressions are visible in PR review.

Acceptance criteria:
- One command or task exercises the listed routes against a running app instance.
- Failures identify the route that broke.
- Artifacts are saved under `artifacts/browser-validation/` or another documented path.

Validation:
- Run the browser smoke workflow locally.
- Confirm artifacts are produced for each route.

Audit note: vetted on 2026-05-24; still relevant because current coverage is primarily API/component-level, not live browser-route smoke coverage.
